name: Soyuz TMA-18
about: Soyuz TMA-18 (2010-011A), a crewed vehicle (7K-STMA), launched 2010 Apr  2. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (DK).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (2010 Apr  4), held fixed
docked to S36086; it stays docked here until it lands, as the undocking is not in GCAT's tables or Wikidata
landing day from Wikidata (P620, Q857018), noon UTC standing in for the hour; the site is the programme's usual landing zone, from memory
